response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but lacks direct experience with embedded networking, Linux kernel modifications, or Japanese language proficiency. Their background in high-level web and backend development does not align well with the embedded security-focused role, which requires deep C programming, kernel-level work, and networking expertise.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship with experience in diverse programming languages (C, C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript)
Proven track record in full-stack development and system architecture
Experience with test-driven development, CI/CD, and dev-ops practices
concerns: No demonstrated experience with embedded systems or Linux kernel development
No mention of security technologies (e.g., MACsec, 802.1X, encryption) relevant to the role
Lacks Japanese language proficiency and experience with networking switch operations
